definitions.gloss: hair dye; hair coloring; the act of dyeing hair
definitions.explanation: Refers to both the product used to color hair and the act of dyeing one's hair. A compound of {髪|かみ} (hair) and {染|そ}め (dyeing).

examples.japanese: {髪染|かみぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髪染|かみぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I dyed my hair at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{髪染|かみぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Since my gray hairs have been increasing, I started using hair dye.

notes:
A straightforward compound noun. Can refer to both the hair dye product and the activity of dyeing hair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪染|かみぞ}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dye one's hair
- ⟦{白髪|しらが}{染|ぞ}め→白髪染め：22007_shiragazome⟧: gray hair dye
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{髪染|かみぞ}め: store-bought hair dye
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to dye one's hair (verb form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヘアカラー→ヘアカラー：27079_heakaraa⟧: hair color — the most common commercial term; often preferred in advertising
- {毛染|けぞ}め: hair dye — an older, less common synonym
- ⟦{白髪染|しらがぞ}め→白髪染め：22007_shiragazome⟧: gray hair dye — specifically for covering gray/white hair

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many schools and workplaces have rules about hair color. {黒染|くろぞ}め (dyeing hair back to black) is sometimes required of students who have dyed their hair.
